activity_summary: You looked at the bundle after the knot. Your hand was flat on the red thread. The private verse was at the far edge, and the two piles did not touch.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Laid his hand flat on the bundle and did not open it again.

entities.name: the fair Romeo bundle
entities.context: Mentioned in Red thread on the bundle

facets.activity: Set a hand on the tied bundle
